content: शम्बूकः [शम्ब्-ऊकः <ls>Uṇ. 4. 43</ls>] .²1 A bivalve shell. (शम्बूका also in this sense). .²2 A small conch-shell. .²3 A snail. .²4 The edge of the frontal protuberance of an elephant. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of a Śūdra (who practised penance though forbidden to his caste and was in consequence slain by Rāma; see {%inter alia%} <ls>U. 2</ls> and <ls>R. 15</ls>).
